query: SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('queueName',q.queue, 'queued',q.queued,'running',q.running,'failed',q.failed)),'[]'::jsonb) FROM ( SELECT queue,count(*) FILTER (WHERE status='QUEUED') queued, count(*) FILTER (WHERE status IN ('LEASED','RUNNING')) running, count(*) FILTER (WHERE status IN ('FAILED','DEAD_LETTER')) failed FROM ops.jobs GROUP BY queue ORDER BY queue) q
